llm.summary: This skill is a narrowly scoped PubMed connector wrapper with disclosed setup steps and no evident hidden or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: Allowed tool scope is limited to Bash commands matching oo *, which is proportionate for a connector skill that operates via the oo CLI.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: First-time setup may install the oo CLI via a remote OOMOL install script and requires OOMOL sign-in/connection only after an auth or missing-command failure.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to inspecting connector schemas and running PubMed connector actions; user confirmation is required for any write/destructive action, though none are listed.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill relies on an OOMOL-connected PubMed account and server-side credential injection, but it does not request raw token handling or background persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to search and read PubMed data through the OOMOL oo CLI, and the listed actions are PubMed read/search/lookup operations.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable routing PubMed queries through OOMOL and using its account connection and billing model. Let the setup commands run only when the CLI or connection is actually missing or expired.
